'''Actuator Power Feeds''', also known as '''Actuator Multicycle Power Feeds''', were components used in [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. They allowed the energy generated in the [[Laser actuator/Legends|actuator]] to be transferred along the weapon.<ref name="EGWT" />
